press_references.value: Holo’s new AI platform rewires the real estate experience for a seamless home-buying journey

product_launches.description: Holo launched a new mobile-first AI platform that serves as an internal command center for its mortgage and concierge teams, streamlining tasks from client conversations to document validation and property matching to speed up the home-buying process.

overview_description.description: Holo is a digital property buying platform, transforming the homebuying process with an integrated, end-to-end digital solution. It provides personalized home loan consultancy and enables users to browse a comprehensive selection of mortgage offerings, including conventional and Sharia-compliant options, guiding them through financing with tools like eligibility checks, calculators, and application tracking. It also offers a white-label solution for real estate partners to embed real-time mortgage advisory into their platforms.

identifier.value: UAE Mortgage Brokerage and Application Platform

product.name: UAE Mortgage Brokerage and Application Platform
product.description: A mortgage comparison and application service that matches UAE homebuyers with lender products and supports eligibility checks, document submission, applications, and approval tracking.

product.name: Holo Concierge
product.description: A buyer-side property advisory service that helps customers search for properties, compare options, assess value, coordinate viewings, and manage the purchase through completion.

product.name: Islamic Home Financing
product.description: A Sharia-compliant property financing service offering structures such as Ijara, Murabaha, and Musharaka through Islamic financial partners in the UAE.

product.name: UK Mortgages for Expats
product.description: A mortgage advisory and brokerage service for expatriates financing UK residential or buy-to-let property, including applications involving foreign income and refinancing.

product.name: Commercial Mortgages and Corporate Financing
product.description: A commercial property finance brokerage service for businesses purchasing, refinancing, or developing offices, retail units, warehouses, labour camps, land, and construction projects.

product.name: Conveyancing Services
product.description: A property legal-transfer coordination service covering contracts, title checks, deposit handling, registration requirements, No Objection Certificates, and ownership transfers in Dubai.
